notes: DiscoFlate v3.25.0 — per-range top-pumper tracking with new [leaderboard_range], [range_leader], and [range_leader_score] placeholders, plus a new 'award_prize' action type that grants a target (e.g. [range_leader]) N charges of a command with the cooldown bypassed — so the range leader can, say, fire a progression command 3× back-to-back.
